bounties.flavor: A small number of oozing creatures have been spotted near the outer trails. Travelers report slick residue on the stones.
A gathering of slimes has taken hold along the forest road. Merchants are refusing the route until the threat is cleared.
A large group of the creatures has colonized the old waystation. The guild considers this an urgent culling.
A few of the glutinous things have crept into the fen paths. Locals say the water tastes wrong near the crossing.
A sizable cluster of slimes has settled in the marsh hollows. Trappers have lost more than one snare to the muck.
A large group of slimes thrives in the deeper fen. Something is drawing them together — the guild wants answers and fewer of them.
A handful of slimes have been sighted on the ridge approach. Few hunters go that way willingly, which is why we're posting this.
A troubling mass of the creatures has spread across the ridge shelf. The last party to scout it did not linger to count them.
A great seething host of slimes blankets the upper ridge. This is not a nuisance — it is an infestation. The guild pays well for resolution.
